requirements.unitRule: Single unit, or any combination of matching-style base cabinets at various widths, total exterior run ≤120". Primary criteria: maximize the total count of 4.4"W × 14"D × 4.4"H storage units that fit across the combination — a bay N inches wide contributes floor(N/4.4) width-multiples, not just a pass/fail.
requirements.storagePreference: Cabinet + adjustable shelves preferred; zero drawers preferred, minimal acceptable. Base cabinets only — no wall-mounted or hanging units.
requirements.dividerRule: A door pair opening onto a single continuous bay passes; a center divider splitting it into narrower bays fails, even if overall width looks sufficient.
requirements.availabilityRule: Must be generally available to purchase now. Temporarily out of stock is fine. Amazon's 'Currently unavailable. We don't know when or if this item will be back in stock.' — the outOfStock block, distinct from a normal restock notice — reads as discontinued and disqualifies a candidate regardless of how well it otherwise passed.

discountCheck.result: No product-specific markdown found on TONSTAD, HAVSTA Sideboard, or HAVSTA Cabinet with Base — each page's own price data shows only the standard current price with no previousPrice/salePrice field. IKEA's active sitewide promo carousel (checked directly in each page's embedded promo data) currently covers mattresses, mattress toppers, KALLAX shelving, dressers, sleeper sofas, desk chairs, and cookware/dinnerware for IKEA Family members through 8/2 — none of it names sideboards, buffets, or cabinets. Re-check periodically; IKEA rotates these promos and a future one could cover this category.

storageUnit.formula: floor(interiorW / 4.4) × floor(interiorD / 14) × floor(interiorClearH / 4.4), computed per bay and summed across every cabinet in a combination.
storageUnit.heightNote: No retailer in this dataset publishes interior clear height (only overall exterior height is published). Every interiorHEst value below is INFERRED using the same ~2" top/bottom panel allowance already observed on TONSTAD's and HAVSTA's own published width offsets — flagged accordingly, not treated as confirmed.

retailerNotes.wayfair: Zero verified passes. Wayfair's own product pages returned HTTP 429 (rate-limited) on every direct-fetch attempt, so results leaned on brand sites and cross-retailer corroboration rather than Wayfair's own diagrams — thinner coverage than Amazon or IKEA got. Results were dominated by the same SimpliHome lines that fail on Amazon. Not yet checked: Wayfair's traditional solid-wood buffet lines (Birch Lane, Sunset Trading, Jofran, A-America, Powell), which typically run 19–21" deep.

combinationRule: Working combinations are only built from candidates with zero deficient criteria (i.e. would qualify standalone) — VIHALS, SEKTION, and the Prepac console are excluded here because combining units doesn't fix an individual unit's own height/depth shortfall. Each family shows only combinations that are practically different from each other: the maximum-slot plan at its lowest cost, a same-slot-count 'swap' variant only if substituting a different model in the same family actually changes the cost/verification trade-off, and a fully-verified alternative only if the max plan itself isn't fully verified. Plain fewer-of-the-identical-model subsets (e.g. 2 when 3 fits) are not shown — they're strictly worse with no offsetting benefit.

combinations.label: 3× TONSTAD Cabinet with Doors
combinations.note: 24.375" of the 120" budget left to spare. A 4th unit would need 127.5", over budget. No other model exists in this family to swap in (TONSTAD Sideboard is the disqualified divided-bay trap), so this is the family's only proposed combination. With the finer 4.4" unit size, HAVSTA's mixed plan below now out-slots this one — TONSTAD remains the fully-PUBLISHED option, not the page-wide maximum.

combinations.label: 1× Sideboard + 2× Cabinet with Base
combinations.note: Highest storage-unit count found anywhere in this dataset — the wider Sideboard is now the most width-efficient model at this unit size (1.47 units/inch vs. Cabinet with Base's 1.32), which is why a Sideboard-anchored mix beats 3 identical Cabinet with Base units outright rather than tying it. Two of the three cabinets' interiors are still INFERRED, not published — verify before ordering all three.

combinations.label: Zero-risk: 2× HAVSTA Sideboard
combinations.note: Only 14 fewer units than this family's mixed maximum (140 vs. 154 — an 9% drop) for $140 less and zero unverified interior data, since the Sideboard's own width efficiency at this unit size makes it a strong option on its own, not just a fallback. The old 3× Cabinet with Base plan is dropped here: it now yields fewer units than this pair at a higher cost with no fully-published data, so it's dominated on every axis.

combinations.label: 1× HAVSTA Sideboard + 1× TONSTAD Cabinet + 1× HAVSTA Cabinet with Base
combinations.note: Requested directly: swapping the mixed HAVSTA plan's 2nd Cabinet with Base for a TONSTAD Cabinet with Doors gives the exact same 154 units at the exact same 111.375" width (both swapped units are 31⅞" wide) for $41 less ($899 vs. $940) — because TONSTAD is $41 cheaper than the Cabinet with Base it replaces. The catch: this deliberately breaks the matching-style rule this page otherwise enforces — TONSTAD and HAVSTA are different IKEA lines with different door/leg design, so the three pieces won't look like one coordinated run side by side. Shown here as the requested cost comparison, not as a page recommendation.
